about: Measured on 2026-10-06 at commit 86b6c1f (master, before the shared writing policy), with no request sent. Characters, not tokens: a chars/4 estimate is roughly 11.3k tokens for each drafting prompt. sha is the first 16 hex digits of the prompt's SHA-256. simulated_cache is the prompt-cache model in tests/test_app.py (_simulated_cache_usage) applied to one hermetic four-turn hyperscale_fire session with a research profile (turns: a drafting turn with one tool round, a text turn, a second drafting turn, a text turn) plus the background compaction request that session would fork; values are characters read from and written to cache per request, in order.
